title: A delegation can complete while its command inventory still lists a command as running, with no terminal evidence for that command
outcome: When a delegation reaches a terminal state, every command in its recorded inventory also has a terminal state: completed with exit, interrupted, abandoned with the child's end, or unknown with an explicit reason. Its start, last-observed time and any error text are kept. No command stays 'running' after its owning child has completed, and the result says plainly when a command's outcome is unknown. Tested with a command that never returns before the child completes.
acceptance: A delegation can complete while its command inventory still lists a command as running, with no terminal evidence for that command is done
